output.summary: Bar widget and panel only. Panel.qml uses XHR to letsfg.co and spawns no processes. It reads ~/.letsfg/config.json for the token and writes its own state files. Scanner hits are in SDK/tools files the shell doesn't load. Panel.qml and Model.js were only grepped.

whatItDoes.oneLiner: A bar widget with a flight-search panel that calls letsfg.co over XHR using the user's LetsFG token, with an anonymous install ID sent for analytics.

additionalFindings.message: Reads the CLI's token file ~/.letsfg/config.json and sends the bearer token to letsfg.co. This is the plugin's stated purpose, and the file is read-only to the plugin.
Generates a random anonymous install ID and sends it to the server as an analytics header (X-LetsFG-Install). It is disclosed in the code comments.
additionalFindings.snippet: An anonymous install id, generated once and kept beside the token.
